content_sections.heading: Mahabubnagar District Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid by the applicant in the shape of a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of the Administrative Officer, O/o DM&HO, MBNR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubnagar District Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the application form and instructions from the official website at https://mahabubnagar.telangana.gov.in under District Notifications. Fill in all required personal and educational details in the application form. Paste one passport-size photograph on the application form and sign across it. Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents along with the Demand Draft for the application fee. Submit the filled-in application form in person at O/o DM&HO, Mahabubnagar District, Room No. 201, IDOC building, Boothpur Road, Mahabubnagar District, on or before 08-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or Equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all years of the qualifying examination Registration Certificate issued by the Medical Council with valid date Latest Caste Certificate issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned (SC candidates must submit the latest caste certificate as per SC Sub-classification) Study Certificates from 1st class to 7th Class (or Residence Certificate from Tahasildhars/MROs of Telangana State in case of private study) PH certificate for candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota (SADEREM Certificate) Relevant certificates for candidates claiming Ex-Service men quota One photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgement card

content_sections.heading: Mahabubnagar District Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done by the District Selection Committee based on merit on aggregate marks obtained in all qualifying examination guidelines combined with age weight-age, following the Rule of Reservation (RoR) and Presidential Orders 2018. Total marks are 100, of which 90 marks are allotted based on marks obtained in the qualifying examination and 10 marks for age (0.5 mark awarded for one completed year of age reckoned from 18 years, up to a maximum of 10 marks, calculated as on 01-07-2024).

content_sections.heading: Mahabubnagar District Important Instructions
content_sections.text: These vacancies are initially filled for a period of one year and are liable to be terminated earlier if regular candidates report for duty, or on grounds of poor performance, or as deemed fit by the Chairman of District Health Society and District Collector. Selected candidates shall maintain the Headquarters. Merit lists will be displayed on the official website of the District Collector for transparency and inviting objections. Postings will be issued after the completion of the selection process as per merit, roster, and options.

faq.question: Q1. What is Mahabubnagar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mahabubnagar District Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment notification issued by the District Selection Committee, Mahabubnagar, to fill 3 contract posts under the NHM Programme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, comprising 2 vacancies for 2nd ANMs and 1 vacancy for an Anaesthetist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Mahabubnagar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled-in application forms in person is 08-10-2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for 2nd ANM posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess SSC with MPHW(F) Training course registered with T.G Para Medical Board, or passed Intermediate Vocational Multi-purpose Health worker (Female) training course with 1 year clinical or apprenticeship training and registration with the Telangana Paramedical Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Anaesthetist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MD in Anesthesia or a Diploma in Anesthesia with TG Council Registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Mahabubnagar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01-07-2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 300/- for General candidates and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of the Administrative Officer, O/o DM&HO, MBNR.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates submit the application form?
faq.answer: Filled-in application forms must be submitted in person at the Office of the DM&HO, Mahabubnagar District, Room No. 201, IDOC building, Boothpur Road, Mahabubnagar District.
